newsitem.title: UK: LGT appoints new CIO after US acquisition.
newsitem.headline: LGT appoints new CIO after US acquisition.

text.p: Liechtenstein Global Trust (LGT) has appointed Roger Yates its International Chief Investment Officer following its recent acquisition of US pension fund manager Chancellor Capital Management (CCM).
A statement from LGT said Yates will oversee the management of both global and international equity and fixed income product groups which invest over $15 billion worldwide.
He will report to Warran Shaw, LGT's global Chief Investment Officer, formerly CE and CIO of Chancellor.
Nick Train has been appointed Head of Investment for Europe, responsible for the investment processes and performance of a team of 22, in addition to running the GT Income fund.

Michael Lindsell, who has led the investment team in Tokyo for the last five years, will return to London to lead the global equity team, reporting to Yates. He is replaced in Tokyo by Andrew Callender.
